title: FUEL & EXHAUST-CONTENTS
summary: Contents of UPC 8, fuel and exhaust: exhaust system, muffler/tail pipe and frame attachment, and exhaust checking dimensions (production and RPO) on the A sheets; fuel tank (gas tank) supports and straps, fuel meter (sending unit) and rear hose, fuel line and clips, and fuel tank filler neck on the B sheets. A frame drawing points to where each sheet applies.
notes_internal: Index page: no parts. Two-line titles joined with a space.

Drawing callouts: B1 fuel tank straps, B2 meter at top of tank, B4 filler neck, B3 fuel lines along the frame, A4 rear of frame/exhaust, A3 muffler, A2 exhaust pipe along the frame. A1 and A5 not called out.
Title block: drawing 3965172; DR AB/C1, CK 4-18-69 C1, PREL 3-7-69, C/O A1; model 19000. Circled (1) at lower right of the drawing; sideways 'K207' at lower left. Rev 1 AUTH illegible.
